method.rule: Adapt the upstream text; do not paraphrase it. The formats and their worked examples are the skill: an example rewritten into this project's own nouns stops being an example of a format and becomes an example of this project, which is the failure mode that produced the corpus this replaces. Every example is kept as upstream wrote it, and only what the workflow changes is edited: where a generated artifact is written, and that a rendered gate packet is never replaced by a visual.
method.reviewNote: Adopted because the local corpus taught one method of writing to the maintainer — subtraction — and named its own failure mode for it. `maintainer-review` documented `emptied prose` and offered no third option. A format is the third option, and no local skill carried one.

retained: skip the preamble and keep prose brief
pick the smallest view that makes the key point clear
call tree for runtime control flow
component tree with the state and module boundaries that matter
shallow file tree for responsibility and broad refactors
mermaid for interaction, control flow and data flow
diff when the point is what changes, matched to the topic
the four diff shapes: component, file layout, call tree, control flow
whole block when most of it is new or the reader needs a copyable target
one focused HTML file for what is too dense for mermaid
place each visual next to the short text it supports
keep only what answers the current question
you may use one, you may use several, it is unlikely you will use all
modified: a generated HTML artifact is written under the bundle's artifacts/ directory and linked from the owning record, rather than left loose
a packet rendered by wfctl work ask is never replaced by a visual; the visual goes beside it
the reader test in maintainer-review governs the prose that carries the visual

notInstalled.reason: Control-loop authoring is not a maintainer-communication concern.
Agent-harness authoring, outside this workflow's scope.
wfctl owns its managed instruction block; a second editor of the same file would fight it.

relatedReading.note: The reasoning behind the formats: a call-stack tree, a file-tree diff and a signature sketch each settle a decision that would otherwise be made implicitly during review, which is the most expensive time to change your mind. This workflow's framing gate exists for the same reason.
